profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer passionate about helping people

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Products/Teams: Sway iOS, Word Online, Seeing AI, Apple Fundamentals (Current)
- Deliver high quality code on the scale of feature architecture to bug fixes
- Mentor junior engineers in both engineering and career skills
- Drive implementation of EU MDR, including architecture of new processes, creation of controlled documentation, risk analysis, and product validation, resulting in successful audit representation for Microsoft’s ISO 13485:2016 certification and launch of a compliant medical device
- Estimate and execute timelines and workback plans for major medical release processes
- Interview candidates for software engineering and software engineering management roles
- Collaborate across disciplines (design, program management, legal, research, accessibility, medical, localization, customer support, etc.) to create the best experience for the customer
- Utilize detailed mindset and diligent testing to catch live-site issues before they ship to customers
- Manage releases for both internal processes and Apple App Store requirements
- Identify and fix accessibility bugs, using knowledge of iOS assistive technology features
- Improve developer efficiency by identifying and eliminating common roadblocks
- Analyze telemetry to make data driven prioritization decisions
- Apply a strong lens of accessibility, user empathy, and diversity & inclusion

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead development for Feather iOS app
- Collaborate with founding team to determine user experience and app strategy
- Mentor other engineers in iOS development

positions.title: WEP Academic Facilitated Study Group Coordinator
positions.description:
- Interview candidates and make hiring decisions for FSG program
- Manage 30+ facilitators to ensure success of each of their groups

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Implement a top user requested feature for Microsoft Office Sway
- Verify feature success through unit testing and agile methodology cycles

positions.title: WEP Academic Facilitated Study Group Leader
positions.description:
- Facilitate 10+ women engineering students’ mastery of Calculus and Computer Science
- Lead weekly sessions; conduct individual reviews utilizing personalized guides

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Teaching Intern
positions.description:
- Supervise students and facilitate operation in CEDE machine shop
- Serve as academic role model for engineering students to facilitate retention
- Deliver case study presentations to facilitate grasp of engineering design process
- Obtain certification in CEDE machine shop; assist engineering instructor

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a replay tool that parses logs and recreates user experiences
- Implemented automation and completed bug fixes for Office Sway
- Increased knowledge base for telemetry density tool

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with software engineers to internationalize proprietary PC application
- Verified requirements for multiple Android applications
- Identified, reported and eliminated software bugs and errors
